# Super Greedy

> Automated futures trading software for ES, NQ, MES, and MNQ.

Super Greedy helps futures traders automate execution during market hours using configurable sessions, bias controls, Trend and Pattern detection, and risk settings. Desktop apps: macOS and Windows.

## Site

- [Super Greedy | Automated Futures Trading Software for ES, NQ, MES & MNQ](https://supergreedy.com/): Main marketing site and product overview
- [Automated Pattern Detection for Futures | Super Greedy](https://supergreedy.com/detection/pattern/): HTML page
- [Automated Trend Detection for Futures | Super Greedy](https://supergreedy.com/detection/trend/): HTML page
- [Sitemap](https://supergreedy.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable URLs
- [This file](https://supergreedy.com/llms.txt): Curated summary for LLMs and agents
